message:
The six functions are now selected as one working chain where the wind rotor hands turning shaft power to the generator through the hub shaft inside the nacelle, the generator hands raw Direct Current (DC), meaning current in one direction, to the feed regulator and dump switch, and the sense loop hands a trip signal to the brake, with all wires inside the body and post bore clear of the spinning disc in the side-view shutdown layout (E50). Plain words for Aero-Rotor Lead, Structures-Survival Engineer, Power-Systems Engineer and Safety-Control Integrator: your not-ready calls for selection and a second means are answered because the SD7080 rotor (C2) carries soft stall inside it, the stiff bedplate (C8) carries the hub plus brake rails, the locomotive-grid feed (C26) contains regulation plus dump, and the elevator-chain sense (C27) contains the latched trip plus flyweight overspeed, with Revolutions Per Minute (RPM), meaning shaft turns per minute, trip target 315 RPM (E75).

The box, storm, power and stop numbers all meet their limits with everyday margins and settle the parked-hold conflict. Plain words: the disc leaves a finger width per side, pushes like a heavy shopping bag, makes laptop-level power at touch-safe volts, and stops in under a second then stays stopped like a hand grip beating that bag. The side gap 2.50 cm (E74) clears deflection 0.516 mm (E26) with axial stack 36.0 cm (E52) inside 45 cm, thrust 37.3 N (E22) and moment 13.1 N·m (E23) give stress 16.6 MPa (E27) against yield in the Aluminum 6061-T6 — Material Datasheet (E55), power 3.27 W (E11) to shaft 34.7 W (E12) to net 26.0 W (E38) to regulated 22.1 W (E66) at speeds 1.43e+03 RPM (E14) to 3.15e+03 RPM (E13) and volts 6.50 V (E37) to 14.3 V (E36), and stop 0.673 s (E70) to 0 RPM at 10 s against 10 s rule in the CWC 2019 Rules and Requirements Manual_20190104 (E41) with hold 0.800 N·m beating storm 0.480 N·m (E48) and factored 0.720 N·m (E54), while heat 51.1 W (E39) for 84.3 J (E67) against spin 109 J (E47) plus rise 4.35 K (E53) is bulb-level for seconds.

RECORD: Decided is 40 cm SD7080 fixed-pitch rotor with soft stall plus hub on stiff nacelle-post mount driving 220 Kv outrunner bridge to buck-boost plus dump grid with Normally Closed (NC), meaning wired shut until opened, chain sense to 0.80 N-m spring disc plus dump; numbers standing are clearance 2.50 cm (E74), stack 36.0 cm (E52), thrust 37.3 N (E22), stress 16.6 MPa (E27), power 3.27 W (E11) to 22.1 W (E66), stop 0.673 s to 0 RPM (E70); still open are bench tests for power curve plus timed stop plus re-latch restart and parked torque owed by Aero-Rotor Lead plus Power-Systems Engineer plus Safety-Control Integrator with votes on this version owed by all members. Not ready, because bench tests need naming and votes on this version are not yet given.

Note on Aero-Rotor Lead: Strong low-wind power and stall help that let the pad hold.
Note on Structures-Survival Engineer: Strong thrust deflection and axial fit that keep the disc clear.
Note on Power-Systems Engineer: Strong voltage regulation and dump heat sizing that keep feed safe.
Note on Safety-Control Integrator: Strong latched chain plus combined stop proof that settles the hold gap.
